title: 2008 HMMT November Guts Problem 19
statement: Let \(P\) be a polynomial with \(P(1)=P(2)=\cdots=P(2007)=0\) and \(P(0)=2009\) !. \(P(x)\) has leading coefficient 1 and degree 2008. Find the largest root of \(P(x)\).

solutions.text: \(4034072 P(0)\) is the constant term of \(P(x)\), which is the product of all the roots of the polynomial, because its degree is even. So the product of all 2008 roots is 2009 ! and the product of the first 2007 is 2007!, which means the last root is \(\frac{2009!}{2007!}=2009 \cdot 2008=4034072\).
